passages.title: How My Parents Met
passages.text:
My parents' love story is not a fairy tale, but it taught me a lot. When my mother was nineteen, she **went out with** a shy engineering student called Hung. Their first **date** was a disaster: he **had got** tomato sauce **on** his white shirt and was too nervous to speak. Still, he **took her to** the lakeside every weekend, and slowly they began to **get to know** each other. They almost **broke up** once over a silly argument, but they were deeply **in love**, so they made peace. **A couple of months** later, Hung **got engaged to** my mother.

The wedding was held the next spring. The **ceremony** was short and traditional, and **afterwards** two hundred guests joined the **reception**, where my grandfather, who is still **alive** and healthy at eighty-five, gave a long speech. Then the newlyweds **went on honeymoon** to the coast, and within a year my mother **got pregnant** with me.

For a long time everything went well, and each **anniversary** was a happy **celebration** with cake and flowers. But when I was ten, things **went wrong**: they argued daily, and eventually they **got divorced**. It hurt, though they stayed polite to each other. **The following year** my father moved abroad, and he found a new job and a new life **as well**. Now I am an adult living **on my own**, and I still believe their early years were real love.

passages.title: Grandma's Wardrobe
passages.text:
I **get on with** my grandmother better than with anyone else, so on Sundays I always **come around** to her small flat. Whenever I arrive, the smell of her cooking seems to **linger** in the hallway for hours. She tells me to **get on with** my homework first, and then we talk about fashion, because her wardrobe is like a museum.

Last week she showed me a silk **scarf** from 1975, a pair of silver **earrings**, a pearl **necklace** and a thin **bracelet**. Then she took out a winter coat with a fur **collar**, one torn **sleeve**, a missing **button**, a deep **pocket** and a broken **zip**. 'I **hardly ever wear** them now,' she said, 'but I cannot throw them away.' Even so, every morning she takes her time to **get dressed**, as if she were going to a party.

Grandma also taught me to **put money away for a rainy day**. When she was young, she left her savings in a **financial institution** and did not touch them **for a period of time** of ten years, and the bank had to **pay interest on** them. 'I **owe** my comfortable life to that habit,' she says. 'Start early, and you will be thankful.' I promised that I would.

passages.title: A Year Abroad
passages.text:
When Minh arrived in Manchester for a year of **vocational training**, he admired the **scenery**: green hills, old bridges and silver skies. **Apart from** the weather, his only worry was English. At home, students are tested **in up to ten subjects**, but nobody had taught him to speak. His dream was to **go into business** with his cousin, although his father, **an engineer**, wanted him to study **engineering**, and his sister, **an architect**, kept praising **architecture**.

One rainy morning Minh slipped on a wet **pavement** and **was injured**. At the hospital the doctor wanted to check his **bladder** and **rectum** for internal damage, but Minh could not describe his pain **accurately** because he did not **have a wide vocabulary**. He **got things wrong** and pointed at the wrong places, which made the nurse smile gently.

The experience changed him. He decided to **become more fluent**, so he would **do some revision** every evening and **do exam preparation** at weekends. He **had problems with** pronunciation, and **in particular** with the 'th' sound. His teacher told him he did not need to **have a good accent**, only a clear one. Gradually he began to **pick things up** from chatting with neighbours, and by summer he could speak **fluently**.

passages.title: Two Sisters, Two Degrees
passages.text:
Linh and Mai are sisters, but their university paths are very different. Linh **got good grades** in biology and chemistry, so she **got a place** at a famous university to **study for a degree** in **psychology**. She dreams of becoming **a psychologist** who helps teenagers. The course will **last** four years: every morning she must **attend a lecture**, every week she has to **write an essay**, and twice a month she will **work in a laboratory** to carry out experiments. At the end she will **have a degree**, namely **a science degree**, which is a valuable **qualification** in many countries.

Mai prefers **arts subjects**. She loves to **work in the library**, where she reads novels for hours. Her favourite **lecturer** introduced her to **Professor** Hall, a famous expert in literature, who encouraged her to teach. To **qualify as** a teacher, Mai must **complete a course successfully** and **receive a certificate** from the education department. A **successful** student, she says, plans carefully, whereas an **unsuccessful** one waits until the night before an exam. She is sure she will **succeed in** becoming a fully **qualified** teacher, because she never gives up.

items.explain: Khóa học kéo dài bốn năm.

items.definition: to go to a talk given by a teacher at university
items.explain: Mỗi sáng Linh dự một bài giảng.

items.definition: to compose a short piece of writing on a topic
items.explain: Mỗi tuần Linh phải viết một tiểu luận.

items.definition: to study or work in a place with books
items.explain: Mai thích học ở thư viện.

items.definition: to do scientific experiments in a special room
items.explain: Linh làm thí nghiệm trong phòng thí nghiệm.

items.definition: an official proof of training, such as a degree
items.explain: Bằng cấp có giá trị ở nhiều nước.

items.definition: to become officially able to do a job
items.explain: Mai phải đủ điều kiện để trở thành giáo viên.

items.definition: to manage to do what you tried to do
items.explain: Mai tin mình sẽ thành công trở thành giáo viên.

items.definition: a teacher at a university
items.explain: Giảng viên yêu thích của Mai giới thiệu cô với giáo sư.

items.definition: a senior university teacher of the highest rank
items.explain: Giáo sư Hall là chuyên gia văn học.

items.definition: school or university subjects such as literature and history
items.explain: Mai thích các môn nghệ thuật/xã hội.

items.definition: a university degree in a science subject
items.explain: Linh sẽ nhận bằng khoa học tự nhiên.

items.definition: having the training or skills needed for a job
items.explain: Giáo viên đủ trình độ: 'qualified'.

items.definition: achieving (or not achieving) what you wanted
items.explain: Học sinh thành công lên kế hoạch kỹ; học sinh không thành công thì để sát giờ thi.

exercises.instruction: Complete each sentence with a word or phrase from the word bank.

items.q: She studied for six years to ____ a dentist.
items.explain: 'qualify as' = đủ điều kiện hành nghề.

items.q: The film will ____ about two hours.
items.explain: 'last' + thời gian = kéo dài.

items.q: After three attempts she finally managed to ____ passing her driving test.
items.explain: 'succeed in doing' = thành công trong việc gì.

items.q: Our history ____ gave a fascinating talk about Rome.
items.explain: Giảng viên đại học là 'lecturer'.

items.q: My uncle is a ____ who studies how people think.
items.explain: Nhà tâm lý học là 'psychologist'.

items.q: At the end of the workshop, everyone will ____.
items.explain: Nhận chứng chỉ khi kết thúc khóa.

items.q: If you study hard, you will ____ in all your exams.
items.explain: Đạt điểm cao: 'get good grades'.

items.q: I like to ____ because it is quiet and there are plenty of books.
items.explain: Học ở thư viện: 'work in the library'.

items.q: What does Linh want to become?
items.explain: Bài nói cô mơ trở thành nhà tâm lý học.

items.q: What must Mai do to qualify as a teacher?
options: Complete a course successfully and receive a certificate
items.explain: Mai phải hoàn thành khóa học và nhận chứng chỉ.

items.q: How does Mai describe an unsuccessful student?
options: Waits until the night before an exam
items.explain: Học sinh không thành công thường chờ sát giờ thi.

exercises.instruction: Write True, False or Not Given.

items.q: Linh's course lasts four years.
items.explain: Bài nói khóa học kéo dài bốn năm.

items.q: Mai prefers science subjects.
items.explain: Mai thích các môn nghệ thuật (arts subjects).

items.q: Professor Hall teaches psychology.
items.explain: Giáo sư Hall là chuyên gia văn học.

items.q: Mai wants to teach in another country.
items.explain: Bài không nói Mai muốn dạy ở nước ngoài.
